# espalier_cluster (Resource)

A local Kubernetes cluster (`container cluster`, experimental in the runtime): a control-plane node and optional workers, each a container. The runtime cannot resize or restart a cluster, so every change of its shape replaces it. A cluster whose nodes stopped or are missing, e.g. after the runtime restarted, is `degraded` and replaced on the next apply.

The provider never touches `~/.kube/config`; write `kubeconfig` to a file yourself, or configure the `kubernetes` and `helm` providers from `api_server` and the credentials. The API server is published on all host addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "espalier_cluster" "dev" {
  name    = "dev"
  cpus    = 4
  memory  = "4G"
  workers = [{ count = 2, cpus = 2, memory = "4G" }]
  cni     = "NONE" # install Cilium yourself

  timeouts {
    create = "20m"
  }
}

# The provider never touches ~/.kube/config: write a file of your own...
resource "local_sensitive_file" "kubeconfig" {
  filename        = "${path.module}/kubeconfig"
  content         = espalier_cluster.dev.kubeconfig
  file_permission = "0600"
}

# ...or configure other providers directly.
provider "kubernetes" {
  host                   = espalier_cluster.dev.api_server
  client_certificate     = espalier_cluster.dev.client_certificate
  client_key             = espalier_cluster.dev.client_key
  cluster_ca_certificate = espalier_cluster.dev.cluster_ca_certificate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the cluster, also the control-plane node's; workers are `<name>-worker-<n>`.

### Optional

- `cni` (String) Path of a CNI manifest to apply, or `NONE` to install none, e.g. to install Cilium yourself. Defaults to kindnet. Creating waits until the nodes are ready, so a manifest that never gets them there runs into the create timeout.
- `cpus` (Number) CPUs of the control-plane node. Defaults to a quarter of the host's, at least 2.
- `memory` (String) Memory of the control-plane node, with an optional `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P` suffix. Defaults to a quarter of the host's, at least `2G`.
- `node_image` (String) Node image. Defaults to the `kindest/node` image the runtime pins; the runtime reports it by digest.
- `scheme` (String) Registry scheme, `http` or `https`, for pulling the node image. Defaults to `https`. Not recorded by the runtime; changing it does not replace the cluster.
- `shared_image_store` (Boolean) Let nodes pull images from the runtime's local image store. Needs the runtime's `cluster-shim`, which Homebrew builds of `container` lack. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `workers` (Attributes List) Groups of equally sized worker nodes. Without workers, the control-plane node runs workloads too. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workers))

### Read-Only

- `api_server` (String) URL of the API server on the host, e.g. `https://127.0.0.1:6445`.
- `client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM client certificate of the admin user.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM private key of the admin user.
- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM certificate of the cluster's CA.
- `id` (String) Name of the cluster.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig with admin credentials, its context named after the cluster.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version of the nodes, e.g. `v1.35.5`.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) The node containers, control plane first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `state` (String) `running`, or `degraded` if a node is not running or missing; a degraded cluster is replaced.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--workers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workers`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Number of workers. Defaults to 1.
- `cpus` (Number) CPUs of each worker. Defaults to a quarter of the host's, at least 2.
- `memory` (String) Memory of each worker. Defaults to a quarter of the host's, at least `2G`.


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IPv4 address on the default network.
- `name` (String) Name of the node container.
- `role` (String) `control-plane` or `worker`.
- `state` (String) State of the container, e.g. `running`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Clusters are imported by name.
terraform import espalier_cluster.dev dev
```
